runs.note: Geneformer (gf-12L-95M-i4096 @ HF 01d3ea89) on an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell; env geneformer-blackwell = paper geneformer_env with torch 2.7.1+cu128 (2.3.0 has no sm_120 kernels). Adamson matches the paper per perturbation (r>=0.999); norman_from_scfoundation uses this benchmark's split, which differs from the paper's (known scf_split caveat).

UCE (uce = 4-layer, uce33 = 33-layer; figshare 24320806 weights) on an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, paper uce env; inference batch per OMNI_UCE_BATCH (batch-independent). Adamson matches the paper per perturbation (max |d pearson_delta| < 5e-4, both variants); norman_from_scfoundation uses this benchmark's split, which differs from the paper's (known scf_split caveat).

lpm with G from scGPT (scGPT_human encoder embedding) / scFoundation (models.ckpt pos_emb), built on CPU by make-gene-emb-*; run locally (laptop). Adamson matches the paper per perturbation (source_data single_perturbation_prediction.xlsx Panel C, max |d pearson_delta| < 3e-6). Predicts only genes the embedding covers (paper behaviour).

scFoundation (forked GEARS 0.0.2 + 0.1B maeautobin encoder, frozen) on an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, env scfoundation-blackwell (torch 2.7.1+cu128); paper batch 6 / epochs 5, full per-epoch train-set eval kept. torch's MHA fast path disabled (segfaults in eval under torch 2.7.1; fp-level deviation only). Seeds 1 and 2 (~81 h each; seed 2 restarted once after an instance reboot). norman_from_scfoundation uses this benchmark's split, which differs from the paper's (known scf_split caveat). scBERT (panglao_pretrain, mirrored HF btraven/scbert-panglao-pretrain, sha256-pinned; paper finetune_modified.py, 100-epoch cap with PATIENCE=10 early stop) on the same box, env scbert-blackwell (torch 2.7.1+cu128); seeds 1 and 2 on both datasets (nfs s2 restarted once after an instance reboot).

scGPT (scGPT_human, scgpt 0.2.1 + flash-attn 1.0.4, torch 1.13.1 cu117; paper run_scgpt.py, batch 64 / 15 epochs / early stop 5) on roland L4 24GB (slurm 7572, ~7.5 h/seed); predict() DataLoader batch 16 via OMNI_SCGPT_PRED_BATCH (inference only). Outputs placed into the OB tree at the plan path and collected on the Blackwell box. norman_from_scfoundation uses this benchmark split, which differs from the paper (known scf_split caveat); shared test perts correlate with the paper per perturbation (r 0.99 / 0.97).
